title: Refined Axe
body:
"After many months of hard work, the axe was finally completed. Eron named it the "Tall Refined axe," (later mistranslated to Refined Axe) and it was truly a work of art. The axe has a long, slender handle made of the strongest fiberglass, and a blade forged from the rarest steel."

The Refined Axe is an axe that is sold at The Oak Depot. It can be bought for $21,000. While it has no special abilities, it is a powerful axe.

Description

The Refined Axe is a tall hatchet with a headpiece made out of steel, using the default legacy metal material for its appearance. The handle is made of wood that has been painted blue, and a rubber grip at the bottom of the handle.

The Refined Axe has a swing power of 0.5, which the second most powerful axe available for purchase.

Trivia

  • When first being added, it was advertised as being a limited time item only, being sold for only 2 days with a ridiculous price tag of $80,000. It went off-sale before returning a few days later: this iteration was hidden on a glass stand without its box, and was being sold for approximately $20,000. Later it was stolen by Jerry and taken to Jer's Junkyard with another price change to $40,340, only to later be brought back to The Oak Depot. In the first Secret Friday Update, the Refined Axe was boxed once more, and the original boxed version has turned golden. With this, the price changed to $8,450, where it has remained since.
  • The Refined Axe is based on a real Kobalt axe that Kinder had laying in his garage.
